key_facts: Updated July 4 (post-Silverstone Sprint Race & Main GP Qualifying; T+1d). Massive Saturday swing back to Antonelli/Mercedes + Leclerc resurgence: (1) Sprint Race (17 laps): Antonelli used Overtake Mode (+30 km/h on Hangar Straight) to cruise past polesitter Hamilton on Lap 8 and won easily by 2.745s (~0.20-0.25s/lap average race-pace & tyre-deg edge over Ferrari); 3. Norris (+9.78s), 4. Russell (+10.64s), 5. Leclerc (+12.62s, matched HAM pace late after poor start), 6. Verstappen, 7. Piastri, 8. Lawson. (2) Main GP Qualifying Grid (no top-10 penalties; Gasly +3 P12->P15): 1. Antonelli 1:28.111 (5th pole in 9 races; Merc 9/9 poles; ran first in Q3 & didn't even touch setup after Sprint), 2. Leclerc 1:28.286 (+0.175s; beat HAM in Q1/Q2/Q3 after setup breakthrough), 3. Hamilton 1:28.458 (+0.347s; lost ~0.3s down back straight to Q3 deployment glitch + understeer/T3 braking; conceded 'if Kimi gets a clean run, he'll be gone', though clean-side P3 launch + 317.9 km/h speed trap + 9x Silverstone winner), 4. Russell 1:28.481 (+0.370s; Q1 Luffield barrier crash/front wing swap + UNEXPLAINED 3-6 km/h straight-line speed deficit vs all Merc-engined cars costing 0.2-0.3s/lap, still unsolved entering Parc Ferme), 5. Hadjar (+0.635s), 6. Norris (+0.766s; admitted 'we're in a pickle, lack downforce, 0.7s slower, P5 is best'), 7. Verstappen (+0.782s; 'down on power on my side of garage, no point racing like this', poor high-speed/deg), 8. Piastri (+0.921s). (3) Sunday weather: warm & cloudy, ~26C dry -> C1/C2/C3 tyre overheating/deg dominant (favoring Merc). Main threats to Antonelli: 2-vs-1 Ferrari strategy (Leclerc P2 + Hamilton P3), Lap 1 start/wind risk, SC/VSC (~18%), and ~10% DNF/incident tail. Updated sharply to Antonelli 0.55 (+0.21), Leclerc 0.18 (+0.12), Hamilton 0.16 (-0.16), Russell 0.07 (-0.07), Norris 0.015 (replaces Verstappen). Outside tail 0.025: Verstappen ~0.010, Hadjar ~0.009, Piastri ~0.004, rest ~0.002.
